company_blurb: Kestrel Labs builds reliable cloud telemetry and data routing software for Nordic enterprises. Headquartered in Helsinki, the company values practical engineering, steady growth, and clear documentation across teams.

departments.culture: The Engineering group values readable code, thorough peer reviews, and sustainable on-call rotations. Discussions center on system reliability, latency metrics, and keeping technical debt manageable through steady iteration.

Finance operates on predictable monthly cycles, accurate reconciliations, and clear audit trails. Team members collaborate quietly and expect budget requests from other groups to arrive with complete documentation.

Legal prioritizes clarity, risk mitigation, and adherence to European data and commercial standards. Work revolves around careful contract redlines, vendor assessments, and keeping internal policies practical and current.

Sales balances ambitious quarterly targets with a cooperative approach to account planning. Representatives regularly trade product demo tips, coordinate closely with operations, and keep pipeline updates timely.

personas.bio: Riikka Makinen is a senior engineer who focuses on backend stability and database tuning. Outside of work, she enjoys winter cycling and restoring vintage mechanical keyboards.
Aleksi Lehtonen builds revenue forecasts and tracks departmental budgets as a financial analyst. He appreciates clean spreadsheets, quiet mornings, and strong filter coffee.
Sanna Rantanen manages mid-market enterprise accounts across Finland and Sweden. She brings steady enthusiasm to client onboarding calls and organizes the office running club.
Joonas Makinen oversees regulatory alignment and vendor contract standards as compliance officer. He favors structured checklists, thorough preparation, and predictable schedules.
Tuomas Lehtinen serves as a financial controller managing monthly close processes and audit readiness. He is known for his methodical reviews and calm demeanor under deadline pressure.
Sanna Lehtonen works with regional logistics clients as an account executive. She enjoys building long-term customer relationships and celebrating team milestones.
Petri Heikkinen maintains the CRM pipeline, territory mappings, and commission reporting in sales ops. He prefers direct requests and clean data entry over long meetings.
Mikko Korhonen handles cost accounting and cash flow tracking as a controller. He keeps his messages brief and spends his weekends sea kayaking in the archipelago.
Venla Salo guides prospective enterprise buyers through product evaluations as an account executive. Colleagues appreciate her helpfulness and willingness to share pitch notes.
Laura Laine coordinates architecture decisions and sprint planning as Engineering tech lead. She mentors junior staff patiently and keeps cross-team discussions constructive.
Petri Kinnunen processes accounts payable, invoicing, and expense reconciliations. He speaks plainly about missing receipts and keeps the ledger strictly on schedule.
Lauri Jokinen works on distributed message queues and infrastructure tooling as a senior engineer. He gives candid feedback during code reviews and dislikes unnecessary complexity.
